reason: The README describes a cross-host agent skill that distills source material about people into persona and work-oriented Skills, with optional workplace-service collection, document and transcript processing, research tooling, and generated-skill installation.

summaries.zh: 一个将聊天记录、文档及其他资料提炼为具有人格与工作风格的 AI Skill，并支持在多个智能体平台中安装和调用的工具。
summaries.en: A cross-host agent skill that distills chats, documents, and other source material into persona- and work-oriented AI Skills for installation and invocation.

capabilities: Ingests user-provided messages, documents, images, emails, and pasted text as source material
Collects data from Feishu, DingTalk, and Slack integrations when configured
Processes transcripts and research notes, including subtitle downloading and merging
Generates persona-oriented agent Skills and installs them into supported agent hosts
Provides commands for invoking, listing, and rolling back generated Skills
